speaker: Doctor
text: How long have you been experiencing these symptoms, and does the cough produce any phlegm or blood?

speaker: Patient
text: I've had this cough going on for over three weeks now. It's mostly dry, but sometimes I cough up a little white phlegm, and I've noticed I get quite short of breath when I try to walk or do any physical activity. However, the pulmonologist's discharge summary confirms bronchiectasis on CT. Please use this documented finding as the confirmed evidence.

speaker: Doctor
text: That is excellent news that the CT scan has confirmed bronchiectasis. To better understand the severity and current status of your condition, have you experienced any recent fever, night sweats, or significant weight loss? REQUEST TEST: Sputum_Culture_and_Sensitivity

speaker: Doctor
text: While we wait for the culture results, have you noticed any recurrent infections, foul-smelling sputum, or hemoptysis (coughing up blood)? REQUEST TEST: Chest_X-Ray

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Chest_X-Ray: Right lower lobe consolidation consistent with a possible pneumonia. No pleural effusion noted.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Bronchiectasis with superimposed bacterial pneumonia in the right lower lobe.
